intro.h2: Tile work and bathroom updates that customers hire again
paragraphs: Tyler Houser Construction handles bathroom remodeling in Funk, NE, from new tile floors to complete shower changes. One family had Tyler replace the old flooring in all three of their bathrooms with tile, and they say the rooms turned out even better than they had imagined when the work began.

That same family had him swap a small corner shower for a larger walk-in shower with a barn-style door, then add new countertops and shiplap on two main bathroom walls. Another customer says Tyler updates you on the project so you know the timeline, and a third calls his tile work phenomenal.

about.text: Tyler Houser Construction is a general contractor working out of 503 Main St in Funk, Nebraska. Tyler leads the work with his team, and customers mention him by name in every review. Tile is the thread that runs through those reviews: new bathroom floors, a walk-in shower built to replace a cramped corner unit, and tile work one customer calls phenomenal. Countertops and shiplap walls round out many bathroom jobs. Call Monday through Friday between 8 AM and 5 PM to talk about your project.

process.h2: How a project with Tyler goes

steps.title: Call the shop
steps.text: Call (308) 920-2616 on a weekday between 8 AM and 5 PM and tell Tyler which rooms you want updated.

steps.title: Walk through the rooms
steps.text: We look at the space with you and talk through tile, shower, countertop and wall choices so the estimate matches what you want.

steps.title: Set the timeline
steps.text: Before work begins you will know the plan, and Tyler keeps you updated on progress so the schedule never catches you off guard.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Our team handles the demolition, tile, fixtures and finish work, keeping each step moving in a timely way.

steps.title: Final look
steps.text: We walk the finished bathroom with you, so you can check the tile, the shower and every detail before we call it done.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Funk, NE and nearby
service_area.text: Tyler Houser Construction is based at 503 Main St in Funk, Nebraska, and works on homes in and around town. If you live outside Funk and are not sure whether your place is close enough, give us a call at (308) 920-2616 on a weekday between 8 AM and 5 PM. Tell us where the house is and what you want done, and we will give you a straight answer.

items.q: What kind of work does Tyler Houser Construction do?
items.a: Google lists us as a general contractor, and most of our reviews come from bathroom projects: tile floors, a walk-in shower replacing a corner shower, new countertops and shiplap walls. Tile work is what customers praise most. If your project is something else around the house, call and ask.

items.q: Can you replace a small corner shower with a walk-in?
items.a: Yes. For one customer, Tyler removed a small corner shower and built a larger walk-in shower with a barn-style door, as part of a project that also included new tile floors and countertops. Call us with the size of your bathroom and we will talk through what fits.

items.q: Will I know when the work is happening?
items.a: Yes. Customers say Tyler updates you on the project so you know the timeline, and that he does his work in a timely manner. You will know what is coming next, and you can reach us on weekdays from 8 AM to 5 PM with any questions.

Our address is 503 Main St, Funk, NE 68940. We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends. The quickest way to reach us is by phone at (308) 920-2616, and you can also email thouserconstruction@gmail.com.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call (308) 920-2616 or use the estimate form on this page. Tell us which rooms you want to change, what bothers you about them now, and share any photos of looks you like. We will set up a time to see the space and go over the work with you.

final_cta.text: Call Tyler to talk about tile, showers and the rest of your bathroom.
